ops.caption: Start BFS at A: enqueue A
Dequeue A: visit A; neighbours B and C are unvisited
Peek: B is next to be processed
Dequeue B: visit B; neighbour D is unvisited
Dequeue C: visit C; neighbour D is already queued — no enqueue
Dequeue D: visit D; neighbour E is unvisited
Dequeue E: visit E; no unvisited neighbours

ops.note: Queue is empty — BFS from A is complete
